title: Charlie Moore - I Believe in the Old Time Way

lines.l: For many long years through this world I have roamed, not thinking of the days yet to come.
But now I have changed and I want the world to know that I'm going to make heaven my home.
I'm going to make heaven my home, I'm left in this world all alone.
No mother or dad, I've lost all I had
And I'm going to make heaven my home
The night seemed so lonely around the cabin home
No mother left to guide us along
But on that golden stair, I'll take her by the hand
Cause I'm going to make heaven my home
I'm going to make heaven my home, sweet home
I've left in this world all alone
No mother or dad, I've lost all I had
And I'm going to make heaven my home
There's things in this world that's hard to understand
Why you have to lose the one that you love so
But it's wonderful to know when you leave this world below
That you're going to make heaven your home
I'm going to make heaven my home sweet home
I've lived in this world all alone
No mother or dad, I've lost all I've had
And I'm going to make heaven
Home
Oh soul, are you weary and troubled No light in the darkness you see
